summary: From a blank file you write the demo check (a helper, one function per beat, a runner with an exit code), then give one real person a dry run of your demo without explaining anything, collect their words on a sheet and sort every line into fix now, say it, or let go, with at most three fixes.
goal: Write the demo check from a blank file and run a dry run for one real person.

items.text: List your beats and what the system must return for each
Write the helper that sends one request and returns the status and the JSON
Write one function per beat and a runner that exits with 1 on a failure
Make one expectation wrong and switch off a service, and read both messages
Run the demo for a friend with the protocol and no explaining
Sort the feedback into three boxes and make at most three fixes
Play the Dry Run game to the end and see your score
